        Scorecard

        Change is measured against February 2026, the last month before call-handling training.

        Dials per specialist per day

        Manual dialing, no auto-dialer. Counts before 12 January 2026 come from phone-system exports.

        Promises to pay that were kept

        Share of promises where the money arrived within three days of the promised date. Specialists only.

        When customers pick up

        Share of calls placed in each hour (Pacific time) before and after training, and how often the call reached the person who pays.

        Card share of past-due cash

        Card payments close on the call; checks take 5–10 days to arrive and clear.

        New specialist ramp, on the onboarding playbook

        Average dials per day by week since the start date, against the playbook ramp target.

        How each number on this desk is calculated

        The desk reads one invoice-level ledger, the call disposition log and the shared request log. Every figure below is computed from those three sources the same way each morning.
